data.one_liner: Deploy Flutter apps to TestFlight and Google Play test tracks with a Dart command.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to deploy their applications to Apple TestFlight and Google Play test tracks using a single command and a local configuration file. It supports app flavors, custom build names, version increment strategies, and submitting directly to store review.
use_when: You want to automate or simplify publishing test builds to Google Play and TestFlight.
Your project uses a Dart-based workflow and you want to avoid complex CI/CD setup for quick deployments.
avoid_when: You already have a comprehensive CI/CD pipeline (like GitHub Actions or Fastlane) handling your deployments.
You need automated deployments for platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Simple command-line execution using 'dart run simple_deploy'.
Supports build version increments and app flavors out of the box.
Allows submitting iOS apps directly to App Store review.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration files such as service account JSON for Android and API keys for iOS.
Limited to Android and iOS test deployments.
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a deploy.yaml file at the project root, setting up App Store Connect API credentials for iOS, and a Google Cloud project credentials JSON file for Android.
